lines.japanese: 「何しに来た」
lines.english: “What are you doing here?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、学園祭来なかったから」
lines.english: “You didn’t come to the festival.”

lines.japanese: 日曜日の夜。
lines.english: Sunday night.

lines.japanese:
峰城大付学園祭も滞りなく後夜祭を終わらせ、
祭りの後の寂寥感が漂っているはずの時間帯。
lines.english: The Houjou High Festival’s closing celebration had ended without incident. This should have been the hour when the melancholy after a festival settled over everything.

lines.japanese:
「…そんなことのために、
わざわざ押しかけたのか？」
lines.english: “…You came all this way for that?”

lines.japanese:
俺は、電車で３駅ほど離れた、
とある一戸建てのインターフォンを押していた。
lines.english: Three train stops away, I stood outside a house pressing the intercom.

lines.japanese:
「心配になるだろ？
つい２日前まで高熱出して寝込んでたんだから」
lines.english: “Of course I was worried. You were bedridden with a high fever until two days ago.”

lines.japanese:
「高熱だったのは３日前までだ。
木曜はほとんど治ってた。
委員長なら細かいところも間違えるな」
lines.english: “The fever broke three days ago. By Thursday I was almost recovered. If you’re going to be class rep, get the details right.”

lines.japanese:
「…なら細かいことを言わせてもらう。木曜朝からの
冬馬の体温の変遷だけど、午前１０時から２時間おきに、
３８度８分、３８度５分、３８度５分、３８度３分…」
lines.english: “Then let’s be precise. Starting at ten Thursday morning, your temperature at two-hour intervals was 38.8, 38.5, 38.5, 38.3…”

lines.japanese: 「…あたしは委員長じゃないからいいんだよ」
lines.english: “…I’m not class rep. I’m allowed to get it wrong.”

lines.japanese: 「とにかく上げてくれないか？」
lines.english: “Will you let me in already?”

lines.japanese:
「若い女が一人で住んでる家だぞ？
お前には常識ってものがないのか？」
lines.english: “A young woman lives here alone. Have you never heard of common sense?”

lines.japanese:
「ここ一週間毎日上がってただろ。
それどころか、毎日のように泊まって…」
lines.english: “I came in every day this past week. I practically slept here every night—”

lines.japanese:
「外でそんなこと喋るな！
近所で妙な噂が立ったらどうする！」
lines.english: “Don’t announce that outside! What if the neighbors start talking?”

lines.japanese: 俺の声よりもインターフォン越しの声の方がでかいんだが。
lines.english: Her voice over the intercom was louder than mine.

lines.japanese:
「…わざわざ夜分遅くに申し訳なくも来たんだぞ？
お茶くらい出すのが礼儀だろ？」
lines.english: “…I’ve gone to all the trouble of imposing on you at this hour. The least you can do is serve me tea.”

lines.japanese:
「突然押しかけてきた招かれざる客に出す茶なんかない。
そもそもお前の言い方は日本文化としておかしいだろ」
lines.english: “No one owes tea to an uninvited guest who turns up without warning. Besides, that is not how hospitality works in this country.”

lines.japanese:
「…どうしたんだよ冬馬？
何かあったのか？」
lines.english: “…What’s wrong, Touma? Did something happen?”

lines.japanese:
どうして昨日の今日で
こんなにもよそよそしくなるんだ？
lines.english: How had she become this distant overnight?

lines.japanese:
…俺のほうの環境の変化なんて
『まだ』知らないはずなのに。
lines.english: She couldn’t possibly know “yet” what had changed on my end.

lines.japanese:
「『何かあったのか』って…
お前的には、何もないんだな？」
lines.english: “‘Did something happen?’ So as far as you’re concerned, nothing did?”

lines.japanese: 「それって、どういう…」
lines.english: “What’s that supposed to—”

lines.japanese: 知らないんだよ、な？
lines.english: She didn’t know. Right?

lines.japanese:
「いつも通りの北原なんだよな？
変な誤解とか、思い込みとかのない、
フラットなお前なんだよな？　って聞いてる」
lines.english: “You’re the same old Kitahara, right? No weird assumptions, no private theories—just you, completely neutral. That’s what I’m asking.”

lines.japanese: 「俺は…俺だよ」
lines.english: “I’m… just me.”

lines.japanese: 「そか…」
lines.english: “Right…”

lines.japanese:
冬馬が、何を聞きたいのかは、
正直よくわからなかったけど。
lines.english: Honestly, I had no idea what Touma wanted to hear.

lines.japanese:
彼女が望む限りは、いつも通りの俺でいようって。
特別な日をまたいでも、変わらない俺でいようって。
lines.english: But if she wanted the usual me, that was what I would be—even now that the special day was over.
“Oh…”

lines.japanese: 「お茶だけ飲んだら…帰れよ？」
lines.english: “You can come in for tea… but then you’re leaving.”

lines.japanese:
その思いが通じたのかわからないけど…
とにかく、天の岩戸が、今やっと開いてくれた。
lines.english: I couldn’t tell whether that thought had reached her. But now, at long last, Amaterasu’s cave had opened.

lines.japanese: 「…なぁ」
lines.english: “…Hey.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「砂糖、６杯目だぞ？」
lines.english: “That’s your sixth spoonful of sugar.”

lines.japanese: 「………いつものことだろ」
lines.english: “…I always use this much.”

lines.japanese: 「そう、か」
lines.english: “Right.”

lines.japanese:
いつもは５杯だったような気がしたけど。
ま、どっちにしてもアレなことに変わりはないけど。
lines.english: I could have sworn it was usually five. Not that either amount was remotely sane.

lines.japanese: …そろそろ飽和量オーバーしてないか、あれ？
lines.english: Hadn’t that coffee passed its saturation point by now?
“…?! Pfft!”

lines.japanese:
「熱いぞ。
気をつけろ」
lines.english: “It’s hot. Be careful.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああ………すまん」
lines.english: “Y-yeah… Sorry.”

lines.japanese: いや薄すぎるだろこれ…
lines.english: No, it was far too weak.

lines.japanese:
上手いこと言うつもりはないんだけど、
ぶっちゃけ黒い白湯だぞ。
lines.english: I wasn’t trying to be clever. This was literally black hot water.

lines.japanese:
「どうして来たんだ…
昨日の今日で、あたしのとこなんかに」
lines.english: “Why did you come… after what happened yesterday? Why come to me?”

lines.japanese:
「さっきも言ったけど、
また風邪ぶり返してるんじゃないかって…」
lines.english: “Like I said, I was worried the fever might have come back…”

lines.japanese:
「ならもうわかったよな？
あたしは健康だ。さっさと帰れ」
lines.english: “Well, now you know. I’m healthy. Go home.”

lines.japanese: 「話があるんだ」
lines.english: “I need to tell you something.”

lines.japanese:
「っ…
お茶を飲むだけって言っただろ？　卑怯だぞ！」
lines.english: “What—? You said you were only staying for tea. That’s not fair!”

lines.japanese:
「いや、お茶を出せとは言ったけど…
て言うかそんな不毛な議論はやめようぜ」
lines.english: “I asked you for tea; I never said that was all I wanted. Anyway, can we stop this pointless argument?”

lines.japanese: 話が進まない…
lines.english: We were getting nowhere.

lines.japanese:
昨夜までの、お互い憎まれ口を叩きながらでも、
少しずつ本音に近づいていった俺たちと、なんだか違う。
lines.english: This felt nothing like last night, when every insult we traded had still brought us a little closer to the truth.

lines.japanese: これって、俺の方が変わった…訳じゃないはずだよな？
lines.english: It wasn’t that I had changed… was it?

lines.japanese:
だって、ここまで徹底して、
意識しないように頑張ってるんだし。
lines.english: I was working so hard not to think about it at all.

lines.japanese:
もう少し後で、お互いの態度が微妙に変わるとしても、
それは今、この瞬間じゃないはずだ。
lines.english: Maybe things between us would shift a little later. But not now. Not this exact moment.

lines.japanese:
「その、なんだ…
話の前に、一つだけ聞きたいんだ…」
lines.english: “Before you start… there’s just one thing I need to ask.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああ…なんだよ？」
lines.english: “S-sure. What is it?”

lines.japanese:
もしかして、あの時いろいろと自分の中身を出し過ぎて、
今になって色々な意味で後悔の念に苛まれてるんだろうか。
lines.english: Had she bared too much of herself that night, only to find herself regretting it now for all sorts of reasons?

lines.japanese:
「まさかとは思うけど…
お前って嘘をついたり、わざと焦らしたりして、
相手の出方を待つような奴じゃないよな？」
lines.english: “I can’t believe I even have to ask, but… you’re not the sort of person who lies or deliberately strings someone along just to see how they react, are you?”

lines.japanese:
「…どうして答えないんだよ？
やっぱ北原ってそういう男なのか？
じゃあ、今日来たのも本当は…」
lines.english: “…Why aren’t you answering? Is that the kind of man you are after all? Did you really come here tonight because—”

lines.japanese: 「いや…そうじゃない人間でありたいと思ってる」
lines.english: “No… I want to be the kind of person who doesn’t.”

lines.japanese:
回答につまったのは確かだけど、
別に図星を指された訳じゃない。
lines.english: I had hesitated, yes, but not because she had hit the mark.

lines.japanese:
「相手に対して誠実で、
嘘も秘密も駆け引きもない人間が理想だ。
…こういう答えでいいのか？」
lines.english: “My ideal is to be honest with people—no lies, no secrets, no games. Is that the answer you wanted?”

lines.japanese:
冬馬が一体、どういう意図をもって
聞いてるのかがわからないから、
汎用的な答えを探してただけで。
lines.english: I had no idea what she was trying to learn, so I had gone searching for an all-purpose answer.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、次の質問だ」
lines.english: “Then here’s my next question.”

lines.japanese:
「冬馬、お前…
さっき『一つだけ聞きたい』って…」
lines.english: “Touma, you just said there was ‘one thing’ you wanted to ask.”

lines.japanese:
「お前がこっちの望むことを
全部話してくれないからだろ！」
lines.english: “Because you didn’t tell me everything I wanted to hear!”

lines.japanese:
「質問には完璧に答えたはずだろ！？
お前の聞き方が悪い！」
lines.english: “I answered your question perfectly! It’s your fault for asking it badly!”

lines.japanese: 「…追加でもう一つだけ答えてくれ」
lines.english: “…Answer just one more.”

lines.japanese: 「…わかった。そうする」
lines.english: “…Fine. One more.”

lines.japanese:
今度こそはお互いに、
今の会話がまるっきり不毛だってことを認めた、らしい。
lines.english: Apparently we had both finally acknowledged that the entire exchange was pointless.

lines.japanese:
「北原が今日、ここに来たのってさ…
あたしに話したいことがあったからなのか？
それとも…あたしに聞きたいことがあったから…？」
lines.english: “Did you come here because you had something to tell me… or because there was something you wanted to ask me?”

lines.japanese:
「………自分のことだ。
冬馬に聞いて欲しい話だよ」
lines.english: “…It’s about me. Something I want you to hear.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そうか…」
lines.english: “I-I see…”

lines.japanese:
これは、俺の決断だ。
だから、冬馬の意見を聞くのは違う。
lines.english: This was my decision. Asking Touma what she thought would be wrong.

lines.japanese:
というより、聞いてどうにかなるようじゃ駄目だから。
今の俺の思いを、自分の意志以外で曲げてしまっては
絶対に駄目だから。
lines.english: More than that, if I could change course just by asking, that itself would be wrong. I could never let anything but my own will alter what I felt now.

lines.japanese:
「ならいいや。勝手に喋れ。
気が向いたら聞いてやる」
lines.english: “Fine, then. Talk all you want. I might listen if I feel like it.”

lines.japanese: 「そういう態度も困るんだけどな…」
lines.english: “That attitude isn’t exactly helpful either…”

lines.japanese:
何を聞かれるのをそんなに恐れていたのか知らないけど、
どうやら自分の心配事がなくなったらしい冬馬は、
いきなり、あからさまにリラックスしやがった。
lines.english: I had no idea what question she had been so afraid I might ask, but the instant that fear disappeared, Touma visibly relaxed on the spot, damn her.

lines.japanese:
…こっちは未だにこんなに緊張してるのに。
言葉とは裏腹に、ガチガチに固まってるってのに。
lines.english: Meanwhile, I was still horribly nervous—stiff as a board, however calm my words might sound.

lines.japanese: …ま、昔からそう見えないのは認めるけど。
lines.english: Though admittedly, no one had ever been able to tell by looking at me.

lines.japanese:
「そういえばさ、今日の学園祭はどうだった？
最終日だったろ？」
lines.english: “By the way, how was the festival today? It was the last day, wasn’t it?”

lines.japanese: 「…そりゃ、楽しかったさ」
lines.english: “…Of course it was fun.”

lines.japanese:
しかも、勝手に話せと言っておきながら、
勝手に話し出しやがった…
lines.english: She had told me to talk, then gone ahead and changed the subject herself.

lines.japanese:
「朝はクラスの方に顔出して、
昼からは大学祭の方も回って、
結局、後夜祭まで参加した」
lines.english: “I helped out with my class in the morning, toured the university festival in the afternoon, and stayed through the closing festivities.”

lines.japanese:
「よくもまぁ、
あんな子供騙しのお祭りを心から楽しめるな」
lines.english: “I don’t know how you can genuinely enjoy such a childish little carnival.”

lines.japanese: 「昨日、間違いなく完全燃焼した奴の台詞じゃないぞ」
lines.english: “Those aren’t the words of someone who gave everything she had yesterday.”

lines.japanese: 「あたしは…別に…」
lines.english: “I didn’t… It wasn’t…”

lines.japanese:
「…後夜祭でさ、
ミス峰城大付の発表があったんだよ」
lines.english: “…They announced Miss Houjou High at the closing festivities.”

lines.japanese:
「どうせ小木曽のぶっちぎりだろ？
あたしらの年代が入学してから、
波乱の起きようがないからな」
lines.english: “Ogiso won by a landslide, obviously. There’s been no possibility of an upset since our year enrolled.”

lines.japanese: 「ま、確かにその通りだったけど…」
lines.english: “Well, yes. That’s exactly what happened…”

lines.japanese:
親志が今年のポイントを
『雪菜が二位以下にどれだけ差を付けるか』
に定めていた通りの、それは一方的な制圧だった。
lines.english: Just as Chikashi had predicted, the only question this year was how far ahead of second place Setsuna would finish. It had been a rout.

lines.japanese:
全有効投票数、６８３票のうち、
実に６割近くの４０２票を獲得しての、
あまりにも箔をつけ過ぎな堂々の三連覇。
lines.english: With 402 of 683 valid ballots—nearly sixty percent—she had claimed her third straight title by an almost embarrassing margin.

lines.japanese:
…ま、その発表を聞いていた雪菜は、
これまたあまりにも微妙な苦笑いを
抑え切れてなかったけど。
lines.english: Setsuna herself had listened to the announcement with a painfully awkward smile she couldn’t quite suppress.

lines.japanese: でも…
lines.english: But…

lines.japanese: 「今年の投票で一番面白かったのは無効票だな」
lines.english: “The invalid ballots were the most interesting part this year.”

lines.japanese:
「へぇ…もう優勝が決まってるから、
ネタに走った奴が多かったのかな？」
lines.english: “Really? Since the winner was obvious, did everyone start writing joke candidates?”

lines.japanese: 「あはは…そうかもな」
lines.english: “Ha ha… Perhaps.”

lines.japanese: 「…何がおかしいんだよ？」
lines.english: “…What’s so funny?”

lines.japanese:
「内訳はさ…
二日目のキーボードの子。サックス吹いてた三年の女子。
小木曽雪菜のバックバンドの女の子の方」
lines.english: “Here’s the breakdown: the keyboard player from day two; the third-year girl on saxophone; the other girl in Setsuna Ogiso’s backing band.”
“…What?”

lines.japanese:
「色んな楽器を持ち替えて弾いてた人。
ストレートロングのベーシスト。
『ＷＨＩＴＥ　ＡＬＢＵＭ』の黒い衣装のコの方」
lines.english: “The girl who kept changing instruments. The bassist with the long, straight hair. The one in black during ‘White Album.’”

lines.japanese: 「３－Ｅ冬馬。冬馬先輩。冬馬。冬馬かずさ」
lines.english: “‘Touma from Class 3-E.’ ‘Touma, the upperclassman.’ ‘Touma.’ ‘Kazusa Touma.’”

lines.japanese:
「そんな独創的な無効票が、全部で５９…
もし集計してたら５位」
lines.english: “Fifty-nine imaginative write-ins in all. If they’d been counted together, you would’ve placed fifth.”

lines.japanese: 発表の後、親志が言ってた。
lines.english: Chikashi had told me about them after the announcement.

lines.japanese:
なにしろチェック欄がないから、
皆の表現方法も様々な創意工夫が見られて、
集計する側としては、苦労と楽しさが絶えなかったって。
lines.english: Since there was no box to check for her, people had invented all kinds of descriptions. Tallying them had been both a nightmare and a delight.

lines.japanese: 「おめでとう、冬馬」
lines.english: “Congratulations, Touma.”

lines.japanese: 「あ…あたしには関係ないだろ！」
lines.english: “Th-that has nothing to do with me!”

lines.japanese:
「これで、お前の凄さを学園内に知れ渡させるという、
俺の野望は成就だ」
lines.english: “My great ambition—to make the entire school recognize how extraordinary you are—has now been fulfilled.”

lines.japanese:
「だからあたしを祝ったってしょうがないだろ。
自分で勝手に祝杯でも上げてろ…」
lines.english: “Then congratulating me is pointless. Pour yourself a victory drink if you want one.”

lines.japanese: 冬馬の望むと望まざるとに関わらず、な。
lines.english: Whether Touma wanted that recognition or not.

lines.japanese:
「ん…そうさせてもらう。
ほら、乾杯」
lines.english: “Gladly. Here—cheers.”

lines.japanese:
言いつつ俺は、コーヒーカップを掲げ、
やっぱり薄くて味がしない上にとうとう冷めてしまい、
もはや飲めるモンじゃなくなってしまった美酒を味わう。
lines.english: I raised my coffee cup and drank to my victory. The coffee was weak, tasteless, and now cold to boot—completely undrinkable.

lines.japanese: 「知るか」
lines.english: “Like I care.”

lines.japanese: 冬馬は…もちろん付き合ってくれなかった。
lines.english: Touma, naturally, refused to join my toast.

lines.japanese:
「体調が良かったんなら、
冬馬も来ればよかったのに。
俺も雪菜も、何回か電話したんだぞ？」
lines.english: “If you felt well enough, you should’ve come. Setsuna and I both called several times.”

lines.japanese: 「そんな妙な空気はゴメンだ」
lines.english: “I could do without that weird atmosphere.”

lines.japanese:
俺がカップを置くと、
わざとタイミングをずらすように、
今度は冬馬がカップを傾ける。
lines.english: When I set down my cup, Touma deliberately waited a beat before lifting hers.

lines.japanese: 「それに、あたしがいたって邪魔なだけだ」
lines.english: “Besides, I would only have been in the way.”

lines.japanese:
…そしていつまで経っても傾けたまま、
底に粘り着いた砂糖が降りてくるのを待っている。
lines.english: She kept it tilted, waiting and waiting for the sludge of sugar stuck to the bottom to slide down.

lines.japanese: 「どうせ、小木曽と二人で回ったんだろ？」
lines.english: “You went around the festival alone with Ogiso, didn’t you?”

lines.japanese:
「ああ…
午後からは大学祭の方も」
lines.english: “Yes… We toured the university festival in the afternoon too.”

lines.japanese: カップに隠れて、冬馬の表情は伺えない。
lines.english: Her cup hid her expression from me.

lines.japanese:
「一緒にタコ焼き食べて、
一緒にリンゴ飴食べたんだろ？」
lines.english: “You ate takoyaki together. Candy apples too, I suppose?”

lines.japanese:
「まぁ…
あと、クレープとか、ラーメンとか」
lines.english: “Yes… and crêpes. And ramen.”

lines.japanese: ただ、時折、肩がぴくんと動く。
lines.english: Only the occasional twitch of her shoulders betrayed her.

lines.japanese: 「後夜祭で小木曽と踊ったか？」
lines.english: “Did you dance with Ogiso at the closing festivities?”
“…Yes.”

lines.japanese: だから、俺の答えに耳を傾けてるのだけはわかる。
lines.english: At least I knew she was listening to my answers.

lines.japanese: 「で、お別れのキスでもしてからここに来たか？」
lines.english: “And did you give her a goodbye kiss before coming here?”
“What…?”

lines.japanese:
そして今、
俺が、目の前でこくんと頷いたのを…
lines.english: And now, without a word, I nodded right in front of her…

lines.japanese: 冬馬は、いつの間にか視界に納めてた。
lines.english: Touma caught the gesture before I even noticed she was looking.

lines.japanese: 「雪菜に、告白した」
lines.english: “I confessed my feelings to Setsuna.”

lines.japanese:
長かった…
前置きが、本当に長かった。
lines.english: It had taken a long time… a very long time, just to get through the preamble.

lines.japanese: 「雪菜は…未だに信じられないけど、ＯＫしてくれた」
lines.english: “Setsuna said yes. I still can’t quite believe it.”

lines.japanese: でも、とうとう来てしまったって気持ちばかりだ。
lines.english: Yet all I could feel was that the moment had finally arrived.

lines.japanese:
もの凄く言いづらくて、
もの凄く気まずい思いを抱えてて。
lines.english: The words were agonizingly hard to say. The awkwardness was almost unbearable.

lines.japanese:
訳がわからないくらい、
瞬間的に喉の奥がからからに乾いて、
その声を絞り出すのに、歯を食いしばった。
lines.english: My throat went instantly, inexplicably dry, and I had to clench my teeth to force out my voice.

lines.japanese:
「だから俺…
だから、その、俺…
雪菜と、つきあうことにした」
lines.english: “So I… so, um, I… Setsuna and I are going out now.”

lines.japanese: それでも、それでもさ…
lines.english: Even so—still—

lines.japanese:
俺は、誰に対しても嘘はつかない。
誰に対しても、誠実でいる。
lines.english: I wouldn’t lie to anyone. I would be honest with everyone.

lines.japanese: さっき、そう誓ったばかりだ。
lines.english: I had sworn to that only moments ago.

lines.japanese: 「あ…雪菜？」
lines.english: “Oh… Setsuna?”

lines.japanese:
「うん、冬馬の家出たところ。
今から帰る」
lines.english: “Yeah, I just left Touma’s house. I’m heading home.”

lines.japanese:
「ん？　なに？
声が小さくてよく聞き取れない」
lines.english: “Hm? What did you say? You’re too quiet; I can’t hear you.”

lines.japanese:
「………ついでにさ、
そんな泣き声じゃ、ますます聞き取れない」
lines.english: “…And I can understand even less through all that crying.”

lines.japanese:
「うん、うん…
だからぁ、考え過ぎなんだって雪菜は。
冬馬がそんな反応するわけないだろ」
lines.english: “Yes, yes… You’re overthinking it, Setsuna. You know Touma would never react like that.”

lines.japanese:
「もちろん…
今まで通り、なんにも変わらない。
俺たち…三人のままだって」
lines.english: “Of course. Nothing will change. It’ll still be the three of us, just like always.”

lines.japanese: 「………本題はそれか」
lines.english: “…So that’s what this was about.”

lines.japanese: 「冬馬には、一番に言うべきだと思ったから」
lines.english: “I thought you should be the first to hear.”

lines.japanese: 「関係ないだろあたしは」
lines.english: “It has nothing to do with me.”

lines.japanese: 「関係なくない」
lines.english: “Yes, it does.”

lines.japanese:
「どんな思考回路だよ…
お前も小木曽も、自意識過剰なんじゃ…」
lines.english: “What kind of warped logic is that? You and Ogiso both think the world revolves around you.”

lines.japanese:
「俺は、たった一日前、
『ずっと三人でいたい』って言った」
lines.english: “Only yesterday, I said I wanted the three of us to stay together forever.”

lines.japanese:
「そうだっけ？
興味なかったからよく覚えてないけど」
lines.english: “Did you? I wasn’t interested, so I don’t remember.”

lines.japanese:
「あの言葉は今だって全然嘘じゃない。
…そりゃ、言ってることとやってることが
ずれてるって言われても仕方ないけど」
lines.english: “I meant every word, and I still do. Though I can hardly object if you say my words and my actions don’t line up.”

lines.japanese:
「忘れてたことを勝手にほじくり返して、
勝手に謝られてもなぁ」
lines.english: “You’re dragging up something I forgot and apologizing for it all by yourself. What do you want me to say?”

lines.japanese: 「だから、三人の間に秘密を持ちたくなかった」
lines.english: “I don’t want there to be secrets between the three of us.”

lines.japanese:
「不快だって、思うか？
許せないって、思うか？」
lines.english: “Does it bother you? Is it something you can’t forgive?”

lines.japanese:
「…どんな理由で？
北原と小木曽がつきあうことに、
あたしがどんな理由でそんな感情を持つって？」
lines.english: “…Why would it? What possible reason would I have to feel that way about you and Ogiso dating?”

lines.japanese: 「…二人の友達を、片方だけひいきしたみたいで」
lines.english: “…Because it feels like I chose one of my two friends over the other.”

lines.japanese:
「そんなの仕方がないだろ。
北原がさ、二人に向ける感情の温度に差があるんだから」
lines.english: “That can’t be helped. You don’t feel the same way about the two of us.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなこと…」
lines.english: “That isn’t…”

lines.japanese:
「簡単な話だ。
そして、最初っから当たり前の話だった。
…小木曽の趣味の悪さはこの際置いといて」
lines.english: “It’s simple. It’s been obvious from the start. Ogiso’s terrible taste aside.”

lines.japanese: 「なぁ、冬馬…」
lines.english: “Touma…”

lines.japanese: 「だから、もういいだろ」
lines.english: “So let it go.”

lines.japanese:
「冬馬と雪菜と俺と…
三人で………いてくれるか？」
lines.english: “Will you… stay with us? You, Setsuna, and me—all three of us?”

lines.japanese: 「あたしはお前を友達だなんて思ったことはないけどな」
lines.english: “I’ve never considered you a friend.”

lines.japanese: 「冬馬…っ」
lines.english: “Touma…!”

lines.japanese: 「離れる理由はないよ」
lines.english: “But I have no reason to leave.”
“What…?”

lines.japanese:
「そんなの、なにもない。
だって、前にも言っただろ？」
lines.english: “None at all. I told you before, didn’t I?”

lines.japanese:
「あたしと全然違う二人が、
あたしと全然違うところで勝手にくっついたって…」
lines.english: “If two people completely unlike me went and got together somewhere far removed from me…”

lines.japanese: 「やっぱり………害なんか、ないよ」
lines.english: “then it still… doesn’t hurt me.”

lines.japanese:
「うん、うん、それじゃ明日…
１０時にそっち行くから。じゃあ」
lines.english: “Mm-hm. Then tomorrow… I’ll be at your place at ten. Bye.”

lines.japanese: 「………おやすみ、雪菜」
lines.english: “…Good night, Setsuna.”

lines.japanese: 結局…
lines.english: In the end,

lines.japanese: 雪菜は、最後まで半泣きのままだった。
lines.english: Setsuna had remained on the verge of tears until we hung up.

lines.japanese:
冬馬が俺に、友達以上の感情はなかったって、
そんな当たり前のこと信じないまま。
lines.english: She still couldn’t believe the obvious truth: that Touma had never felt anything for me beyond friendship.

lines.japanese: …彼氏の言葉を、信じないまま。
lines.english: She couldn’t believe her own boyfriend.

lines.japanese:
ま、仕方がないか。
何しろ俺たち、始まってまだ二日目なんだから。
lines.english: Well, I couldn’t blame her. Our relationship was only two days old.

lines.japanese:
これから絆を深く、
そして強くしていかなくちゃならないんだから。
lines.english: From here on, we would have to build something deeper and stronger between us.

lines.japanese: 「にしてもなぁ…」
lines.english: “Still…”

lines.japanese: 俺が“あの”小木曽雪菜の彼氏、か。
lines.english: Me, going out with Setsuna Ogiso of all people.

lines.japanese:
多分、学園内の誰もが…
二日前の俺も含めて誰もが、
こんな展開、予想してなかったんじゃないかと思う。
lines.english: Probably no one at school—not even the me of two days ago—could have imagined things turning out this way.

lines.japanese: 「やべ…」
lines.english: “Crap…”

lines.japanese:
そんな急転直下の近未来に思いを馳せてるうちに、
いつの間にか、電車がホームに近づいてくる。
lines.english: As I lost myself imagining how abruptly my immediate future had changed, my train drew into the station.

lines.japanese:
携帯をポケットにしまい、
代わりに定期入れを取り出すと、
俺は、現実を思い出させる人混みの中に、分け入っていく。
lines.english: I put my phone away, took out my train pass, and plunged into the crowd that called me back to reality.

lines.japanese: だから…
lines.english: And so,

lines.japanese:
ここで、俺が夢想していた、
もう一つのあり得ない未来を、切り捨てていく。
lines.english: I left behind the other impossible future I had been dreaming of.

lines.japanese: な、冬馬…
lines.english: Touma…

lines.japanese:
俺…初めて会ったときから、
ずっとお前のことが好きだったよ。
lines.english: I loved you from the day we met. All this time.

lines.japanese:
秘密はないって言ったくせに、早速秘密の話だけど…
もう二度とそんなふうに思わないから、いいよな？
lines.english: I’d just said there would be no secrets, and already I was keeping one. But I’d never feel that way again, so that made it all right… didn’t it?

lines.japanese: いいよな、冬馬…？
lines.english: It’s all right, isn’t it, Touma?
